name: The wolf-men of the Howling Vale

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: At Forest Song, Melyria measures the sentinels’ work against a forest that will not quiet. Her report speaks of the struggle against demons pressing out of Felwood, while a ruined shrine near the northern border has been overtaken by mysterious wolf-men. Their cries have given the hollow its name. She asks the seeker to read the Tome of Mel’Thandris and learn what may have drawn them there. That is the first question the Classic chain sets before us: a sacred ruin, a strange pack, and a record whose workings no one fully understands.
